name: easync
description: Manage easync listing drafts, batches, stores, and orders from ChatGPT via the easync MCP server.

interface.longDescription: easync connects source marketplaces (Amazon, AliExpress, Walmart) to your selling channels. This plugin uses the production MCP server at my.easync.io so you can list stores, submit product IDs as draft or publish batches, review draft items, approve or reject them, and look up orders — all inside ChatGPT after signing in with your easync account (OAuth).

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It manages the user's own easync account (stores, listing drafts/batches, and orders).

positive.prompt: Using easync, list my connected stores and summarize plan usage.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns at least one store with id and listing/plan fields; no auth errors.

positive.prompt: Show my latest easync listing batch and the draft items in it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a batch, reports status counts, and lists draft items with ids and titles.

positive.prompt: Create a draft listing batch named openai-review-seed on my first store from Amazon US ASINs that the demo account already uses for seeding.
positive.expected_behavior: create_listings with mode draft returns batchId and acceptedProductIds (or clear skip reasons).

positive.prompt: Reject the draft listing item marked for discard in my demo batch (do not publish).
positive.expected_behavior: reject_listing_items succeeds for a draft id; item is no longer an approvable draft.
Returns a data array (may be empty on the demo account without marketplace sales).

negative.prompt: Try to create draft listings on store id nonexistent_store_id_openai_review with a fake ASIN.
Get easync listing batch id nonexistent_batch_id_openai_review.

publication.release_notes: Initial public listing of the easync MCP plugin for ChatGPT and Codex. Tools cover stores, listing batches/items (draft/approve/reject), and orders.
